claims.claim: In-plane sheet conductance is integral sigma_parallel dz; scalar Rs is reciprocal
claims.conditions: Continuous connected layers, shared in-plane electric field, ohmic scalar conductivity; SI units
claims.inference: Independent extension of current integration to layers
claims.limitations: Not cross-plane transport, tensor coupling, contact resistance or percolation

claims.claim: Low-field same-sign layered Hall sheet concentration is S1^2/S2 and Hall mobility is S2/S1
claims.conditions: Hall factor 1 in every layer; independent parallel single-carrier channels; low field
claims.limitations: No code implementation/experimental verification; invalid for arbitrary multi-carrier or high-field case

claims.claim: Scaling N,mass by c and optical mobility by 1/c leaves the Drude spectrum identical
claims.conditions: Fixed epsilon_inf and Lorentz oscillators, single Drude term
claims.inference: Algebra from invariant omega_p squared and gamma
claims.limitations: Shows structural ambiguity of this parameterization; does not assert all measurement modalities are ambiguous
